common.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select the text and copy it by hand.
common.tryAgainLater: Try again in a little while.

insecure.title: This connection is not secure
insecure.text: Over plain HTTP, downloads are held in memory instead of streaming to disk, and an upload that breaks off cannot resume. Open this page over HTTPS for large files.

home.claim: Into the castle it goes. Only the recipient gets in.
home.drop: Drag files in, paste or pick them. We're not fussy.
home.trust: Nobody can peek into your files. Pinky promise, encrypted with maths.

resume.title: Unfinished upload
resume.text: An upload stopped before it finished. Pick the same files again and it carries on where it left off.
resume.wrongFiles: These are not the files of the unfinished upload. Pick exactly the same ones.

gate.title: Upload password
gate.text: Whoever runs this castle asks for a password before anyone can send files. Links you get still open without it.
gate.wrong: That password did not work. Try again?

options.filesHint: Every file is encrypted in your browser before it leaves.
options.expiryHint: After this time the files are deleted from the server.
options.downloadsHint: Once deletes the files right after the first download.
options.passwordHint: The recipient needs it as well as the link. Send it another way.
options.passwordShort: That works. With 8 characters or more, the password is much harder to guess.
options.metadataHint: Camera details and the GPS position come out of JPEG photos before encrypting.
options.emptyHint: Add some files to send them.

upload.cancelQuestion: Stop the upload? Nothing is shared, and the parts already sent are deleted.
upload.failed: The upload did not go through. Try again?
upload.limit: You have sent as much as this server takes for now.
upload.quota: The server has no room left for these files.
upload.tooLarge: These files are larger than this server takes.
upload.noResume: Resuming after a reload needs HTTPS. Over this connection, an upload that breaks off starts over.

done.title: Share link
done.hint: Anyone with this link can open the files until they expire.
done.noteHint: Anyone with this link can read the note until it expires.
done.qrSaved: QR code saved as a PNG
done.manageHint: Keep this one to yourself. It deletes the share before it expires.
done.manageRow: Manage the share and delete its files

receive.title: Shared with you
receive.lastDownload: This is the last download. The files are deleted afterwards.
receive.saveFolderHint: Writes every file into a folder you pick, without a zip.
receive.noPreview: No preview for this kind of file
receive.previewLimited: No previews here, since each one would count as a download.
receive.tooLarge: Too large to preview. Download it to open it.
receive.previewFailed: The preview did not load. The download still works.
receive.lockedText: The sender locked these files with a password. They should have sent it to you separately.
receive.wrong: That password did not open the files. Check it and try again.
receive.decryptedHere: Decrypted in this browser. The server never sees the files.
receive.failed: The download did not work. Try again?
receive.busy: The last download of this share is running right now. If it breaks off, it can still be finished, so try again later.
receive.tooMany: Too many wrong passwords or too many requests.

note.title: Write a note
note.hint: The note is encrypted in your browser and shared like a file.
note.label: Note
note.tooLong: That note is too long for one share.
note.receivedHint: Reading it counts as a download, like saving a file.

gone.expiredText: The sender chose a time, and it has passed. Ask them to send the files again.
gone.burnedText: These files could be downloaded a set number of times, and that number is used up. They are gone from the server.
gone.missingText: This link leads nowhere. The share may have expired, been used up or deleted, or a letter got lost while copying the link.
gone.nokeyText: The part of the link after the # holds the key, and it did not arrive. Ask for the whole link again.

manage.title: Manage share
manage.deleteHint: Removes the files and the link right away.
manage.deleteQuestion: Delete this share now? The link stops working for everyone, and this cannot be undone.
manage.deletedText: The files and the link are gone.
manage.deleteFailed: Deleting did not work. Try again?
manage.notFoundText: This management link is incomplete, or the share has already expired or been deleted.

request.title: Ask for files
request.intro: You get two links. Whoever has the request link can send you files, and only your collect link opens them.
request.warning: Anyone with the request link can upload to it, so give it only to the people you ask.
request.expiryHint: After this time the request and everything sent to it are deleted.
request.maxUploadsHint: How many times files can be sent to the request.
request.maxSizeHint: In megabytes per upload, counted after encryption, which adds up to about 12% to the files.
request.requestLinkHint: Send this link to whoever should send you files.
request.collectLinkHint: Keep this link to yourself. Nothing else opens what arrives.
request.failed: The request could not be created. Try again?

send.title: Someone asked you for files
send.intro: Your files are encrypted in this browser. Only the person who asked can open them.
send.cap: This request takes up to {size} per upload, counted after encryption, which adds up to about 12% to the files.
send.sentText: Only the person who asked can open it.
send.closedText: It does not take any more uploads.
send.notFoundText: This request has expired, or the link is incomplete.
send.tooLarge: That is more than this request takes, which is {size} after encryption.
send.busy: Too many uploads to this request are running right now. Try again once one of them has finished.

collect.title: Files sent to you
collect.emptyHint: Whatever is sent through the request link shows up here.
collect.unreadableText: Anyone with the request link can send something that no key opens. Delete it.
collect.deleteFailed: Deleting did not work. Try again?
collect.closeHint: Deletes the request and everything sent to it.
collect.closeQuestion: Close the request now? Everything sent to it is deleted, and this cannot be undone.
collect.closedText: Everything sent to it is deleted.

general.rememberHint: Expiry, download limit and metadata come back the next time you send.
general.expiryHint: What a new share starts with.
general.metadataHint: Switched on for every new share that holds JPEG photos.
general.pasteHint: Files you paste anywhere on the page are picked up, such as a screenshot. Text pasted on the start page opens a note.
general.quietHint: Leaves out routine confirmations. Problems still show.
general.celebrateHint: A short burst of colour when the link is ready.

look.themeHint: System follows the device and switches with it.
look.oledHint: Pure black behind the dark theme, for OLED screens.
look.cornersHint: How round every card, button and field is.
look.motionHint: Off keeps everything still. Wild lets the castle show off.
look.buttonsHint: Words, words with a symbol, the symbol alone, or the word on hover.
look.accentHint: The colour of what is active or chosen.
look.rainbowHint: Every card and control takes its own colour.
look.reactiveHint: Colours rest in grey and light up under the pointer.

oled.refusal: OLED only darkens {dark}, or {system} while the device is dark. With {light} chosen it has nothing to do.

builds.serverHint: CastleParcel runs as one small container on your own server.

info.report: Problems, wishes or suggestions? You're welcome to open an issue on GitHub, or come say hi on Discord.
info.bugSaved: Bug report saved, with no passwords or keys inside
info.body: A one-knight crusade: good-looking open-source tools that did not exist in the shape I wanted, built until nothing is missing. It is free, with no accounts, no telemetry, no ads and no paid tier. No asterisk anywhere. Nothing readable ever leaves your own walls. Forged on evenings and weekends, with heart and stubbornness.
info.coffee: If CastleParcel has earned a place on your server or computer, toss a coin to your knight: it helps cover the costs and keeps the project alive. It also makes this knight's heart beat a little faster. Three ways below, whichever suits you.
info.appeal: Toss a coin to your knight: it covers part of the costs and keeps the project alive. Everything I build costs nothing and shows no ads.
info.coffeeText: Buy Me a Coffee takes cards and Apple Pay or Google Pay. The page opens in a new tab.
info.paypalText: PayPal opens in a new tab, with or without an account.
info.cryptoText: Pick a currency, then send to the address it shows.
info.notesFailed: Couldn't load the release notes here. Open them on GitHub.

signin.name: Name
signin.codeTip: The app shows a new six digit code every 30 seconds. Without your phone, one of your recovery codes works too.
signin.badCode: The code does not match. Take a fresh one from the app or a recovery code.
signin.logCodeTip: The code is in the log of the CastleParcel container: on Unraid in the Docker tab, click the icon, then Logs. It works for 10 minutes. The reset signs out every other session and takes away your API tokens, passkeys and two-factor authentication.
signin.shortHint: Under {min} characters. That works, though a longer password is harder to guess.
signin.longer: A longer password would be harder to guess.
signin.resetRejected: The code is wrong or has run out. If it ran out, the log shows a new one now.
signin.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
signin.resetDone: Your new password is set, and every other session has ended.
signin.resetServices: Sign-in services stay paused until a test sign-in works again.
signin.bye: You are signed out. See you soon!
signin.again: Your session ran out. Please sign in again.

needsPassword.title: Ready once there's a password
needsPassword.reason: CastleParcel is open to everyone right now, so this has nothing to guard yet. Set a password above whenever you like, and this is ready.

notLocal.title: This comes from your sign-in service
notLocal.reason: You sign in through {name}. Set up two-factor authentication and passkeys there.

password.hint: A password of {min} characters or more is hard to guess, though a shorter one works too. Changing it ends every other session.
password.openHint: Until a password is set, CastleParcel is open, and everyone who reaches it is an admin.
password.viaService: You sign in through {name}, so this account has no password here.
password.saved: Password saved. Every other session has ended.
password.first: Password set. From here on CastleParcel asks for it
password.removeText: Without a password CastleParcel opens for anyone who reaches its address. These go with it:
password.removed: Password removed. CastleParcel opens without signing in

askPassword.title: Password check on changes
askPassword.hint: Before a sensitive change, CastleParcel can ask for your password, so you don't have to sign out and back in.
askPassword.label: Ask for the password on changes
askPassword.when: These changes want a sign-in from the last 10 minutes, or 5 through a sign-in service: a new API token or passkey, setting up two-factor authentication, new recovery codes, and adding or changing a sign-in service and its test sign-in. Typing your password counts as signing in again. With the question off, CastleParcel sends you to sign in again instead. Changing or removing your own password always asks for the current one.
askPassword.on: CastleParcel asks for your password before sensitive changes.
askPassword.off: The question is off. Sensitive changes need a fresh sign-in.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.hint: After the password CastleParcel also asks for a code from an app on your phone.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the six digits it shows.
twoFactor.sixDigits: Enter the six digits from the app
twoFactor.codesText: Each code signs you in once if your phone is missing. You only see them now, so keep them somewhere safe, in your password manager for example.
twoFactor.newCodesReady: The new codes work, the old ones no longer do
twoFactor.offText: Enter a code from your app or one of your recovery codes. After that the password alone signs you in.
twoFactor.turnedOff: Two-factor authentication is off. The password alone signs you in now

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.hint: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, your face or your device's PIN. Your password keeps working.
passkeys.noneHint: Add one and you sign in here without typing.
passkeys.removeText: {name} won't sign you in after this. The password keeps working.
passkeys.nameHint: So you recognise the device in the list later.
passkeys.unavailableTitle: No passkey can be added here
passkeys.unavailable: Browsers tie a passkey to a domain name with a trusted certificate. Open CastleParcel under its name over HTTPS, and you can add passkeys here.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: Every device and browser you're signed in on right now.
sessions.othersEnded: All other devices are signed out

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.hint: Scripts and other programs sign in with an API token, without your password. A token may never do more than you.
tokens.noneHint: Scripts and other programs sign in with one.
tokens.endsWhenClosed: ends once CastleParcel asks for a sign-in
tokens.openHint: CastleParcel has no password yet. A token made now stands for you and stops working once CastleParcel asks for a sign-in, after a first password or a first sign-in service.
tokens.revokeText: Whatever uses {name} won't get in after this.
tokens.nameHint: What the token is for. It shows up later in the list of tokens.
tokens.shownText: Copy the token now. CastleParcel never shows it again, you can only create a new one.

services.title: Sign-in services
services.hint: A sign-in service signs people in over OpenID Connect, and the sign-in page shows its button while it's on.
services.mustTest: It turns on once a test sign-in has worked.
services.removeText: {name} won't sign anyone in after this. Its accounts stay and can still get in another way.
services.pickHint: CastleParcel knows the right settings for the services listed here. Any other service with OpenID Connect goes through Other sign-in service.
services.ownHint: Any service that speaks OpenID Connect. You fill in the scopes and where names and groups come from.
services.searchNone: Nothing matches {query}. Other sign-in service takes any service with OpenID Connect.
services.formHint: Create an application for CastleParcel at {name} and give it the redirect address below. The address, client ID and secret come from there.
services.whoGetsIn: {name} decides who may sign in, for example through its groups.
services.roleHint: Whoever {name} lets in for the first time gets the role {role} here.
services.openBinds: CastleParcel has no password yet. A test sign-in that works makes your account at {name} the owner here and turns {name} on. From then on everyone signs in, and you come back signed in through {name}. Turning the last service off opens CastleParcel again.
services.issuerHint: The service's own address, where it publishes its OpenID details, such as https://id.example.
services.secretKept: Saved. Leave it empty to keep it.
services.redirectHint: Enter this address at the service. It sends you back there after the sign-in.
services.label: Name on the sign-in page
services.unreachable: CastleParcel can't reach {address}. Is the address right, and can the container get there?

reauth.title: Your password, please
reauth.text: You signed in a while ago. Enter your password to go on with the change.

errors.accountOwner: The owner stays an admin, and nobody can block or remove that account.
errors.badRequest: CastleParcel didn't understand that request. Please reload the page and try again.
errors.caInvalid: That doesn't look like a certificate in PEM form.
errors.cancelled: The browser didn't make a passkey.
errors.confirmOff: This change needs a fresh sign-in. Sign out and back in, then try again.
errors.crossSite: That request didn't come from CastleParcel's own page, so it was refused.
errors.forbidden: Your account may not do that.
errors.internal: Something went wrong inside CastleParcel. The container log says more.
errors.issuerInvalid: That address doesn't look like a sign-in service.
errors.lastWayIn: That's the last way in, so it stays unless the owner, freshly signed in, takes it away.
errors.nameTaken: That name already belongs to another account.
errors.noAccount: There's no account with that name.
errors.notFound: That's gone already. Reload the page to see what's there now.
errors.notJSON: CastleParcel didn't understand that request. Please reload the page and try again.
errors.notLocal: This account signs in through a sign-in service, so it has no password here.
errors.notOwner: Only the owner can do that.
errors.notWithToken: An API token can't do that. Sign in with your browser instead.
errors.offline: CastleParcel does not answer right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.passkeyRefused: The passkey didn't work. Try again or use your password.
errors.passkeysUnavailable: Passkeys don't work at this address.
errors.passkeyUnknown: This passkey can't sign you in here.
errors.passwordSet: This account has a password already.
errors.passwordShort: The new password needs at least {min} characters.
errors.resetRefused: That code is wrong or has run out.
errors.secretAgain: The address or the client changed, so enter the client secret again.
errors.serviceChanged: This sign-in service changed a moment ago. It's reloaded, so look it over and test again.
errors.serviceOff: That sign-in service is switched off.
errors.serviceUnknown: CastleParcel doesn't know that sign-in service.
errors.serviceUnreachable: CastleParcel can't reach the sign-in service right now.
errors.serviceUntested: It turns on once a test sign-in has worked.
errors.setPasswordFirst: This needs a password of your own first.
errors.setupExpired: The setup took too long. Please start it again.
errors.signInAgain: This change needs a fresh sign-in. Sign out and back in, then try again.
errors.stepExpired: That took a little too long. Please sign in again.
errors.throttled: Too many tries. Try again in {retry} seconds.
errors.wrongCode: The code doesn't fit. Take a fresh one from your app.
errors.uploadPassword: Enter the upload password first. Until you set a password of your own, it guards this page too.

arrived.addressMissing: CastleParcel doesn't know its own address yet, so the sign-in service can't send you back. Set BASE_URL on the container.
arrived.flowExpired: The sign-in took too long. Please try again.
arrived.identityTaken: This person at the sign-in service already belongs to another account.
arrived.linked: The sign-in service is linked to your account.
arrived.nameMissing: The sign-in service sent no name.
arrived.nameTaken: That name already belongs to another account here.
arrived.noAccount: There's no account here for that person yet.
arrived.renewNeeded: Your sign-in at the service has run out. Please sign in again.
arrived.serviceChanged: The sign-in service changed while you were away, so the test didn't count. Look it over and test again.
arrived.serviceOff: That sign-in service is switched off.
arrived.serviceRefused: The sign-in service didn't confirm the sign-in.
arrived.serviceUnknown: CastleParcel doesn't know that sign-in service.
arrived.serviceUnreachable: The sign-in service couldn't be reached.
arrived.testOk: The test sign-in worked, and the service is on the sign-in page.
arrived.throttled: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.

signin.ownerOnly: Only the owner sends parcels from this castle. Sign in to open the gate.
